brief:
Israeli occupation authorities have initiated prosecution against Sheikh Ikrama Sabri, the preacher of Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The legal action marks a continuation of Israeli court cases against prominent Palestinian religious figures connected to the sacred site.

Sheikh Sabri has long served as a leading voice at Al-Aqsa, one of Islam's holiest locations. The specifics of the charges leveled against him were not detailed in available reporting. His prosecution adds to a pattern of Israeli legal proceedings targeting Palestinian clerics and activists affiliated with the mosque complex in occupied East Jerusalem.
